status: AI SAMPLE, pending Brian accuracy review
method: Image-generated dry source and surface-only wet edit, followed by mechanical registration, a shared original cutout and shadow, and identical crop and export transforms.
opaque_alpha_normalization: Alpha values of 240 and above are normalized to 255 inside the solid stone, with the original soft edge retained.
geometry_limit: The silhouette, framing, and shadow match exactly. Generated internal features still have small measured residual drift; do not claim every internal feature is pixel-perfect.
